subject: Simple relation conditions
notes: SR3 (cite.py OK). The only literal class outside the list is boolean: a boolean literal against a numeric item (`IF NI = B"1"`) and ALL boolean against alphanumeric (`IF X1 = ALL B"1"`) are refused COBOL0844; alphanumeric, hex, national, numeric literals and alphanumeric figuratives are accepted. A boolean literal against a boolean operand is a Format-2 relation, not Format 1. (Two-literal relations are GR-13's prose rule, not SR3.) No negative golden located isolating a boolean LITERAL in a general relation. [editions as adjudicated: 85, 2002, 2014, 2023 (boolean literals, the excluded class, exist from 2002)]
